title: Austin Street Widening, Police Arms & Summer Breaks
summary:
*   **Street Expansion:** Approved the acquisition of land and allocated $155 (supplementing $95 in public contributions) for the widening of San Pedro Street.
*   **Police Arms Policy:** Established a new regulation requiring special policemen to obtain explicit written authorization from the City Marshal to carry firearms.
*   **Special Police Appointments:** Confirmed the appointment of 40 individuals as special policemen, notably including Tom J. White (Colored), under the newly implemented arms policy.
*   **City Employee Holidays:** Granted City Hall office employees a half-holiday on Saturdays during the summer months, from June 1st to October 1st.

BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: That the Mayor be and he is
hereby authorized to accept said deeds, and the City Clerk is hereby instructed to issue
